heroHeadline: Oil Price Forecasts Rise as Markets Flag Lingering Hormuz Disruption Risk
heroSubtitle: Market analysts raised oil price forecasts citing continued shipping uncertainty in the Strait of Hormuz, even as throughput approaches pre-war levels — keeping upward pressure on global crude prices
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports (FAO, World Bank, IMF, IEA, WFP), major outlets (Reuters, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, CNBC), and institutional analyses (Lloyd's List, S&P Global, IFPRI, Atlantic Council).
